text:
Maya (CS Ops): Hey team — kicking off prep for StellarPay's upcoming QBR on Friday. Need a tight 12-slide deck: current onboarding state, product adoption highlights, renewal posture, risk radar, enablement asks, and a short runbook for SRE. Can folks claim slides and ETA? Deck: https://redwood.app/decks/stellarpay-qbr

Leo (AM): I'll take onboarding + adoption. Will pull 7- and 30-day DAU/WAU and the onboarding completion funnel. ETA Wed 4pm.

Grace - AE: I'll own the renewal posture slide and the competitive notes. Renewal is ~45 days out. I've got procurement contact names. Will add negotiation levers. ETA Thu noon.

Noah Eng: I'll create the runbook + incident play for the integration (2 pages). Also add one short snippet for alerting. Do we want retention logs?

Iris PM: Yes please include a brief quality signal section — we should surface prompt regression checks and top failed prompts. I'll draft the failure examples and mitigation steps. ETA Wed EOD.

Maya (CS Ops): Sounds good. Mini action list: Leo — slides/03-onboarding-funnel.png; Grace — slides/07-renewal-and-levers.png; Noah — slides/10-runbook.pdf; Iris — slides/05-quality-signals.png. Please tag reviewers in the notes.

slides-bot: Deck created: https://redwood.app/decks/stellarpay-qbr (owner: Maya). Reminder: design review Tue 6pm PT.

Grace - AE: Flag for renewal slide: propose a short pilot upsell for Dedicated with a performance SLA. Need confirmation of current token spend baseline (billing link in notes).

Leo (AM): Baseline token spend attached in notes: billing.redwood/stellarpay/summary. Current seats = 12, committed term 12 months. Usage spiked 2x last week due to batch inference job. We're tracking.

Noah Eng: Adding guardrail alert. Sample Prometheus rule below — tweaking thresholds for StellarPay traffic profile:

```yaml
alert: StellarPayHighLatency
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{team="stellarpay"}[5m])) by (le)) > 0.12
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: "See slides/10-runbook.pdf"
  summary: "StellarPay p95 > 120ms"
```

Iris PM: For quality signals slide: adding two failed prompt cases (entity hallucination on receipts; token truncation on long receipts) + suggested prompt templates and post-processing checks. Will link eval run IDs.

Maya (CS Ops): Risk radar — Leo pls add a short risk score (Low/Medium/High) and one mitigation per risk. Grace, add the procurement timeline to the renewal slide.

Grace - AE: Done. Procurement timeline in notes. Also added three exec asks: 1) approve Dedicated pilot for 30 days, 2) commit to an exec review after pilot, 3) sign off on a promotional usage credit to test Dedicated.

Leo (AM): I'll annotate the adoption slide with source links (product analytics + onboarding tracker).

slides-bot: Slide uploaded by Leo (AM): slides/03-onboarding-funnel.png

Noah Eng: Uploaded runbook at slides/10-runbook.pdf and included the alert rule.

Maya (CS Ops): Two remaining asks: 1) Everyone add a one-line talking point for their slide (what we want the exec to do). 2) Tag a reviewer in the notes. I'll run a dry run Wed 7pm PT.

Iris PM: Talking point: "Approve workshop to validate prompt templates and reduce misclassification by 25%". Reviewer: @Noah Eng.

Grace - AE: Talking point: "Greenlight 30-day Dedicated pilot with rollback SLA". Reviewer: @Leo (AM).

Leo (AM): Talking point: "Commit to a joint executive check-in post-pilot; provide procurement support". Reviewer: @Maya (CS Ops).

Maya (CS Ops): Perfect. Closing checklist before dry run:
- [ ] All slides in deck and named per slide map
- [ ] One-liner exec asks present
- [ ] Sources/links attached to numeric claims
- [ ] Runbook and alert snippet included
- [ ] Dry run Wed 7pm PT scheduled

slides-bot: Reminder scheduled: dry run Wed 19:00 PT.

Grace - AE: Quick note — competitor running a limited POC; added a short slide on what we should emphasize (SLA + migration plan).

Maya (CS Ops): Thanks. If any blocker pops up DM me. I'll post the final deck link after design pass.

slides-bot: Deck updated by Iris PM: slides/05-quality-signals.png

Maya (CS Ops): Final — if all good I'll send the pre-read to StellarPay execs Thu morning. :email:
